rounds.text: Conceded: [E1], [E2], [E26], and [E27]. Despite seemingly attractive headline multiples and deep discount models, the fundamental reality is undermined by a complete lack of direct cash return to shareholders. Specifically, the dividend yield sits firmly at 0.00% [E4], offering zero income generation for those holding the equity at the current market capitalisation of ₹ 23.7 Cr [E3]. Furthermore, the stock lingers in the lower half of its yearly movement, sitting only 40% of the way up its 52-week range between a low of 110 and a high of 170 [E5]. This subdued positioning relative to its yearly span signals a distinct lack of buying momentum or sustained market conviction, regardless of what theoretical discounted cash flow models imply. Investors relying solely on mathematical undervaluation metrics ignore the tangible reality that capital remains trapped without yield.
